← Pneumatic Components

Connector Generator

The printable pneumatic connectors: a male part with 3 mm tubes, a female part with O-ring seals, and two clips that hold them together.

Parts to print

Female back socket: 4.05 for a 4 mm tube. The clip set is one plain clip and one with a notch.
O-rings: pause the print at Z = 2.0 mm, before the first layer above it (it covers the grooves), press a 3x1 mm O-ring into each groove, and resume.

View

Both parts with their tubes and O-rings. Left half of the slider: the male part goes in (clips open); right half: the clips close over the female part. The notched clip sits at the end with the female part's ridge. The view shows all parts; downloads are the print layout of the ticked ones.
Shown and saved in print orientation: the male part on its mating face (glue crosses up), the clips lying flat (6 mm high), the female part on its mating face, side by side; in the 3MF and STEP files each is a separate body. Glue the 3 mm tubes into the male part so they stick out about 4 mm, and the 4 mm tubes into the back of the female part. Insert each clip sideways onto its tab, then turn it 90°.
Enter dimensions and click Generate.
